name: autonr-yarn
description: Static tier, then the live tier (public testnet reads, no keys, nothing signed). Commands for a project scaffolded with yarn.

commands.name: install
commands.purpose: Install the foundry, agent and nextjs workspaces. Keep the name 'install' so the harness can skip it when the dependency fingerprint is unchanged.

commands.name: lint
commands.purpose: eslint on the dashboard and the agent (max-warnings 0) and forge fmt --check plus prettier on the foundry scripts.

commands.name: check-types
commands.purpose: tsc --noEmit for the dashboard and the agent.

commands.name: foundry-test
commands.purpose: AgentVault unit, fuzz and invariant tests, including the executeSwap check-order and network-parity tests. Offline; fork tests run only under foundry:test:fork. Needs forge < 1.8 on the host.

commands.name: agent-test
commands.purpose: vitest for strategies, decision encoding, oracle math parity, red-team scenarios and the verifier (honest and tampered fixtures). Offline, no keys.

commands.name: build
commands.purpose: next build of the dashboard with no packages/agent/.env; the build makes no network calls.

commands.name: live-hcs-decisions
commands.purpose: Mirror Node: decision topic 0.0.10821549 has a submit key and holds at least one single-chunk, <= 1024-byte, valid autonr.decision/v1 record citing the vault and paid by the agent it names.

commands.name: live-vault-trade
commands.purpose: Mirror Node: vault 0x037b24d59836e1C0cb9Fe571f004409D81eba472 has a SUCCESS executeSwap whose logs include TradeExecuted from the vault, citing topic 0.0.10821549.

commands.name: live-verify
commands.purpose: The template's own verifier re-checks the reference trade from public Mirror Node data (12 checks: hash match, HCS-before-trade ordering, same key, schema, content and oracle match, atomic trace, execution quality).

commands.name: live-red-team
commands.purpose: eth_call simulations from the agent's address against the live vault: oversize, unlisted token, unapproved fee tier, missing reasoning, replayed reasoning and a non-agent caller must all be refused with their expected custom errors. Nothing is signed. The env prefix pins the reference deployment over any shell value.
